where: The Three Hours' threshold — the moment an Hour is met, just before its set-piece battle
mood: A single great bell tolls the hour: deep, awed, with a long shimmering tail.
core_styles: low timpani swell under the bell
high shimmering celesta and bell motes
sparse and spacious with warm reverb
short complete sting with a ringing tail

sections.name: Toll
sections.text: {one deep low bell toll on A with a soft low timpani swell underneath, then a few quiet high shimmering bell motes drifting down as the toll rings out to silence}
